Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Molly Round Marble and Stainless Steel Side End Table
Colors: Grey
Materials: Metal
This retro piece will give a fashionable twist to any room where a side table is needed. Along with being a great conversation piece, it's a handy place for you and your friends to leave keys, phones and coffee cups. 17.7"L x 17.7"W x 19.7"H White marble top and bottom, brushed stainless steel Retro and fashionable Convenient side table for living room, bedroom or even bathroom No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
